_title: Shot Çarkı - Party Wheel Game with Dares
_description: Shot Çarkı is a fun party wheel game for 2–12 players. Spin the wheel, get a dare by difficulty, complete it for points or take a shot. Highest score wins!
hero_lead: Shot Çarkı is a party wheel game for friends. Add 2–12 players, spin the animated wheel, get a task by difficulty level — complete it for points or take a shot. Highest score wins!
levels_desc: Harder tasks are rarer but worth more points.
how_desc: Simple rules for a loud game night.
how_1_d: Choose 2–12 players and enter everyone’s name.
how_2_d: On your turn, tap Spin. The wheel lands on a difficulty.
how_3_t: 3) Do it or take a shot
how_3_d: Complete the task and tap Done for points — or take a shot and skip the points.
how_4_d: Track scores and shots anytime. Most points wins!
feat_desc: Built for parties, dorm nights and friend hangouts.
f_1_d: Smooth 5-second spin with real weighted odds.
f_2_d: ~30 tasks per level — from verbal fun to physical dares.
f_3_d: Live scoreboard with points and shot count.
f_4_d: Jump straight into the game without signing up.
warn_desc: This is an entertainment app. Don’t force anyone. Don’t overdo alcohol. Players under 18 should not drink.
